steps.text: run the totality oracles being refuted in one batched run confirmed with run --each (run --invariant <name>... --each), and see each green batched and alone
steps.leaves: run record for the bullets, pass; per-test run record, pass

steps.text: stage the smallest break that changes the behavior the bullet claims, not the strings the detector reads; read the diff to confirm the edit touched only the lines you meant
refute <component>/<name> --broke "<what you changed>"; the detector fails on its own assertion, not by a hang, a kill, a timeout, or what an earlier test left behind
steps.leaves: run record for the bullet, refutation red

steps.text: restore the source byte for byte: from HEAD when the code under test is committed, and from a copy taken before the break when it is not
steps.leaves: the file matches its state before the break (git diff against HEAD, or cmp against the copy)

steps.text: run them again in one batched run confirmed with run --each, and see each green batched and alone
steps.leaves: run record for the bullets, pass; per-test run record, pass

steps.text: when the red did not come from the break, record a decision that this refutation does not count and refute again; the run store is append-only, so the correction is a later record

pitfalls: a sed matched two lines, so the test hung and went red only when it was killed (d-828ddc83)
a substring detector passed an unconditional early return that kept every expected string (df-c40bb904, x-429ed176)
the red came from the selected test depending on what earlier tests appended, not from the break (d-c4be0b1a, df-9e673484)
a self-asserted refuted: line read as witnessed, and an automatic refutation proved the instrument reports a site, not that the classifier calls it a bypass (df-b9b2711b, df-87881a8d)
a break that turns a test red when the via does not test the claim refutes nothing; record unable instead (u-2e6ee400)

chose: Record dark: the leaderboard's totals keep counting every Given message while everyone-board is off; only what members see is gated
over: Record nothing while off, and backfill when the flag turns on
because: Totals are a projection of awards that affects no award or permanent effect (O35 does not bind them), reading a flag in the kudosGiven subscriber would put the flag in the core loop's transaction (O33 says a flag never gates the core loop), and counting dark means the board is right the moment the flag turns on and stays right through off/on toggles without a second backfill run

chose: Gate the Everyone board on a workspace-subject flag read in the mutation that decides what the member sees (the command's isEveryoneBoardShown, App Home's shownTabOf, the click's runCommand), with the exposure sent from that mutation
over: A member-subject flag, or reading the flag in a query from the action
because: A board is shared by the whole workspace, so a workspace half-on would show members a board others cannot see (#83 asks for a workspace subject); a query cannot create the workspace key or send an exposure (O36), so the decision is made in a mutation

chose: Send no exposure while the flags key is unset
over: Send a false exposure for every member whenever capture is on, key or not
because: Without the flags key the seam evaluates nothing and answers the safe default, so a false exposure would claim a decision PostHog never made; it would also add $feature_flag_called to every key-less deployment's core-loop events

chose: While everyone-board is off, an App Home click left from while it was on runs no command and republishes App Home without tabs
over: Ignore the click and publish nothing
because: Republishing replaces the stale tabbed view the member clicked, so turning the flag off hides the slice even for a member whose App Home still shows it, and storing nothing keeps their settings as they were for when it comes back
